cheap_filter_method: For every seed row visible to `scripts/qbank/profile_contrast_retrieval.build_retrieval_index` across all 3 frozen curated packs (competitive_contrast_seed_pack_r4.json, _g2_extensions.json, _g2_targeted.json; 81 rows total, real function call, not reimplemented), enumerated the distinct `anchor_study_unit_id`/`anchor_topic` pairs the seeds were originally authored against. Result: exactly 6 distinct anchor study units exist in the entire curated library -- SU-C-21 (Acute Coronary Syndrome), SU-GS-76 (Appendicitis), SU-OB-54 (Mastitis), SU-P-147 (Bronchiolitis), SU-PH-07 (Screening Principles and Screening Biases), SU-PS-12 (Depressive Disorders). None of the 24 remaining opportunities' own study units (SU-D-21/23/24/26/38, SU-OB-53, SU-GY-03/04/10, SU-P-099, SU-PH-34/35/36, SU-PM-06/10, SU-PS-29, SU-OT-52) match any of these 6, or are clinically/conceptually related to their differentials (dermatology vs. bronchiolitis/mastitis/appendicitis/depression/screening-bias/ACS have no shared plausibility). The baseline_indexed_count>0 seen in the manifest for several of these opportunities (LD-D21-01/D23-02/D24-01/D26-01/D38-01 at 3; LD-ONB2-GY-IMAGING/LD-PH34-01/LD-PH34-02/LD-PH36-01 at 4) reflects rows sharing discipline/item-archetype/option-set-archetype TAGS ONLY (e.g. MEDICINE + DIAGNOSIS_SET), not any genuine clinical relationship to the opportunity's own stem -- which is exactly why `build_retrieval_index`'s SAF_1 rule correctly refuses all of them (STEM_PLAUSIBILITY_ANCHOR_ABSENT).
hash_method: sha256 of json.dumps(doc, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)+"\n" with raw_supply_sha256_before_review temporarily set to empty string "" before hashing (matches jsonio.write_json_atomic serialization); hash_method itself included in the hashed document at its final text.
independent_review_rationale: Zero relations or feature extensions were proposed (candidates: []), so there is nothing for a fresh independent-review subagent to adjudicate this wave. No review subagent was spawned.
option_a_assessment: NOT_ATTEMPTED_THIS_WAVE. Authoring a whole new curated-seed-pack-shaped file (targets/seeds + companion .enrichment.json + companion .stem_anchors.json, independently reviewed, hash-frozen, matching competitive_contrast_seed_pack_g2_targeted.json's schema) for even one of these 24 study units would require: (1) discovering a genuine, evidence-grounded competitor concept per target from the opportunity's own or adjacent cited source packets, (2) authoring condition predicates and enrichment tags, (3) authoring a stem-anchor row, (4) an independent review pass, (5) a content-hash freeze -- a materially larger unit of work than a bounded discovery-plus-review pass, and judged NOT tractable within this wave's scope per the task's own guidance not to let it balloon into an open-ended retrieval-architecture rewrite. This judgment matches the prior session's conclusion for the dermatology cluster and is recorded here as a deliberate scope decision, not an oversight.
option_b_assessment: VOCABULARY_EXTENSION_BLOCKED for all 24. Option (b) (propose an evidence-grounded SHARED_PLAUSIBILITY_FEATURE extension to a frozen stem-feature-map so an EXISTING curated seed's anchor gate can fire) requires an existing curated seed that is genuinely clinically plausible as a competitor for the opportunity. None exists: the cheap filter above shows the entire 81-row curated library covers only 6 topics (ACS, appendicitis, mastitis, bronchiolitis, screening bias, depression), none of which bear a real clinical relationship to dermatology (D-cluster), consent/MAID law, postpartum OBGYN diagnostics beyond mastitis (already exhausted in wave 1), contraception/hysterectomy/imaging choice, AOM, workplace-hazard/programme PHELO, alcohol-use-disorder pharmacology, or croup. Registering a SHARED_PLAUSIBILITY_FEATURE tying e.g. a lipoma-vs-cyst dermatology stem to the bronchiolitis-pack's competitor rows would assert a clinical plausibility relationship that does not exist in evidence -- forbidden by the anti-hallucination contract. Marked NO_SAFE_ITEM / VOCABULARY_EXTENSION_BLOCKED honestly rather than forced.
